summary: ManpowerGroup Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders on May 8, 2026. Shareholders approved an amendment and restatement of the 2011 Equity Incentive Plan, increasing authorized shares by 1,100,000 and extending the plan to 2036; an amendment to articles of incorporation allowing director removal with or without cause; and a corresponding bylaw amendment. The filing also includes election of directors, ratification of auditors, and advisory say-on-pay votes. This is a routine current report on shareholder meeting outcomes and governance amendments, not a special situation.
